bio.text: Fred Allen represents District 77 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes part of Pulaski County, and is serving his eighth term.
Allen graduated from Middle Tennessee State University with a degree in business administration.

He worked as an administrative aide to U.S. Senator David Pryor and as a senior executive assistant to the Governor of Arkansas, and has served as a parole commissioner on the Arkansas Post Prison Transfer Board and as a planning commissioner for the City of Little Rock.
